text: 1. Eligibility. A level is eligible iff all of these hold: (a) declared-delta and liveness passed; (b) fidelity: intended = served on 100 % of receipts; (c) measured X1 activation ≥ 0.25 for conditional knobs; (d) unresolved slots ≤ 10 % of planned; (e) no confirmed answer-key or tamper veto; (f) mean $/trial ≤ 2.0 × the baseline's. 2. Score. Δ̂ > 0 qualifies. 3. One level per factor. 4. Count. m_max = 2. 5. Ties. Within 1/(|D_A|·k), by lower $/trial, then registry order. 6. Combination. An optional pre-declared combination C₁₂, confirmation-only. 7. No candidate. withheld{no_candidate}, with the publishable statement "no explored level had a positive exploration estimate under the frozen rule". 8. Determinism. The selection packet is a pure function of the committed X1 records.
